parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set routing-instances vpn1 instance-type.explanation: 配置路由实例的类型为虚拟路由器。

set routing-instances vpn1 route-disting.explanation: 配置路由实例的路由区分器。

parameters.name: route-distinguisher
parameters.explanation: 路由区分器，用于在MPLS VPN中唯一标识路由。

set routing-instances vpn1 vrf-import 2:.explanation: 配置路由实例的VRF导入策略。

set routing-instances vpn1 vrf-export 2:.explanation: 配置路由实例的VRF导出策略。

set protocols mpls label-protocol ldp.explanation: 配置MPLS的标签分发协议为LDP。

set protocols bgp group neighbor-4.4.4.9.command: set protocols bgp group neighbor-4.4.4.9 type external
set protocols bgp group neighbor-4.4.4.9.explanation: 配置BGP邻居组的类型为外部。

set protocols bgp group neighbor-4.4.4.9.command: set protocols bgp group neighbor-4.4.4.9 local-address 3.3.3.9
set protocols bgp group neighbor-4.4.4.9.explanation: 配置BGP邻居组的本地地址。

set protocols bgp group neighbor-4.4.4.9.command: set protocols bgp group neighbor-4.4.4.9 peer-as 200

set protocols bgp group neighbor-4.4.4.9.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] family inet [parameter2]

set protocols bgp group neighbor-4.4.4.9.explanation: 配置BGP邻居组的地址族为IPv4单播。

set protocols bgp group neighbor-4.4.4.9.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] family inet [parameter2]
set protocols bgp group neighbor-4.4.4.9.command: set protocols bgp group neighbor-4.4.4.9 family inet vpnv4
set protocols bgp group neighbor-4.4.4.9.explanation: 配置BGP邻居组的地址族为IPv4 VPNv4。

set protocols bgp group neighbor-4.4.4.9.command: set protocols bgp group neighbor-4.4.4.9 send-community extended
set protocols bgp group neighbor-4.4.4.9.explanation: 配置BGP邻居组发送扩展社区属性。

parameters.name: send-community
parameters.explanation: 发送社区属性的类型，例如extended。
